title: Govern Copilot agents
subtitle: Inventory agents, record key details, rank risk and retire stale or exposed agents.

steps.title: Inventory all agents
steps.evidence: Inventory every Copilot Studio and SharePoint agent across all environments.

steps.title: Record owner and status details
steps.evidence: recording its builder, timing, environment, publication status, owner, sources, connectors, actions and sign-in requirement.

steps.title: Rank risk by exposure factors
steps.evidence: then rank risk by data sensitivity, action breadth and autonomy.

steps.title: Retire stale or unpublished agents
steps.evidence: Ask owners to unpublish or delete agents unused for 90 days or drafts left unpublished for 30 days, and record each decision.
